newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Incentive says major buy not on agenda.
newsitem.headline: Incentive says major buy not on agenda.

text.p: Swedish investment and medical technology group Incentive said on Wednesday a large acquisition was not on the agenda, although it had regained its financial strength with the sale of ABB AB shares.
Incentive announced on Wednesday that it was selling half of its stake in Sweden's ABB AB for 12.4 billion crowns.

The timing and size of the sale coincided with the group's acquisition of Vivra, the second largest dialysis provider in the United States. The tender offer for Vivra was successful and closed earlier this week.
"The sale will restore our financial strength to exactly the level existing before the acquisition of Vivra," Incentive's chief executive Mikael Lilius told journalists at a telephone conference.
"Right now we will, however, focus on integrating Vivra with (medical technology unit) Gambro. A large acquisition is not on the agenda now."
